test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A policeman notices a thief from a distance of 220 m. He chases the thief when he started running the moment he saw the police. The thief and policeman run at the rate of 9 km/h and 11 km/h respectively. How much distance policeman has to cover for catching the thief?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance between policeman and thief = 220 m = 0.22 km

Speed of thief = 9 km/h

Speed of policeman = 11 km/h

**Formula used:**

Relative speed = Speed of policeman - Speed of thief

Time taken to catch = Distance / Relative speed

Distance covered by policeman = Time × Speed of policeman

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 11 - 9 = 2 km/h

Time taken to catch the thief = 0.22 / 2

⇒ Time = 0.11 hours

Distance covered by policeman = Speed of policeman × Time

⇒ Distance = 11 × 0.11

⇒ Distance = 1.21 km

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
